address: Monkey Island Lane, Bray, Maidenhead, SL6 2EE
bio: Enjoy a luxury Afternoon Tea at Monkey Island Bar & Brasserie, a quintessential and exclusive hotel that captures Monkey Island Estate's unique heritage.  Afternoon Tea can be enjoyed in the elegant main dining room or on the garden terrace with a picturesque view of the seven-acres of stunning gardens alongside Berkshire's River Thames.  The menu features a selection of classic finger sandwiches including the Loch Duart Salmon & Cream Cheese and Truffle Egg & Chive Mayonnaise, accompanied with an array of seasonal cakes and pastries. Choose from a wide range of the finest teas and infusions to enjoy with this delicious menu.  Monkey Island Bar & Brasserie is close to Windsor Castle and Legoland Windsor Resort, a nd is within close proximity to Railway Bridge and Burnham Train Station.
